# Artifact Gateway v0.6.1

## 简体中文

本补丁修复原生备份工具拒绝正式 Go trimpath 发行二进制的问题。在 bundle 外独立批准的 Release spec 中，可用 `nativeArchive {path, sha256}` 固定官方原始发行包的完整摘要，绑定同包 version、完整 revision、platform、gateway 字节与全部 migration SQL。module/platform、完整 binary SHA256 和数据库完整 migration ledger 校验继续执行。只有 BuildInfo 完全缺失 `-ldflags` 字段时才从受信归档补足身份；保留该字段、错误或空注入值、篡改、重放和不匹配仍拒绝。身份验证离线、只读，不执行二进制来建立信任。孤立 VERSION.txt、自带摘要和任意旁路 metadata 不能授予信任。

正式 v0.5.0/v0.6.0 原始公开资产通过静态正负回归与隔离 PostgreSQL/RustFS 导出、验证、恢复，源与 sentinel 保持不变；未来实际 Linux 发行包执行同一身份门。非 GNU 构建主机生成规范 USTAR。既有 tag 和发行资产保持原样。

操作时先独立核对官方 tag 对应的完整 commit、release API 与 SHA256SUMS，并将批准的完整摘要保存在 bundle 外受控 spec 中。此信任边界不覆盖发行者/spec 被攻陷或批准后同机恶意并发修改。快照一致性仍依赖完整停写范围，配置与加密 key 仍需独立保管；生产升级与部署另行验收。见 [恢复手册](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.1/docs/recovery-runbook.zh-CN.md)。

## English

This patch fixes native backup tools rejecting formal Go trimpath binaries. An independently approved Release spec outside the bundle can pin the complete official archive digest with `nativeArchive {path, sha256}`, binding its version, full revision, platform, gateway bytes and every migration SQL file. Module/platform, complete binary SHA256 and the complete database migration ledger remain mandatory. Archive identity applies only when the entire BuildInfo `-ldflags` setting is absent; retained settings, incorrect or empty injected values, tampering, replay and mismatches still reject. Identity verification is offline and read-only and never executes a binary to establish trust. Standalone VERSION.txt, self-provided checksums and arbitrary side metadata cannot grant trust.

Original public v0.5.0/v0.6.0 assets pass static positive/negative regression and isolated PostgreSQL/RustFS export, verification and restore with source/sentinel state unchanged. Future actual Linux packages run the same identity gate. Non-GNU build hosts produce canonical USTAR. Existing tags and release assets remain unchanged.

Independently check the official tag's full commit, release API and SHA256SUMS before recording approved full digests in the controlled spec outside the bundle. This boundary does not cover a compromised publisher/spec or malicious concurrent local mutation after approval. Snapshot consistency still requires the complete stopped-writer scope; preserve configuration and encryption keys independently. Production upgrades and deployments require separate acceptance. See the [recovery runbook](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.1/docs/recovery-runbook.md).
